# scripts/Import-CurrentStateFacts.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Checks a redacted current-state snapshot (contract C11, avd-current-state-facts/v1) and files it in the estate vault's facts store.

avd-current-state's avd_current_state_facts.ps1 turns collector and validator packages into a snapshot with no names, IDs, IP addresses, tags or free text: counts, booleans, public Azure values and keyed pseudonyms. It is the fact layer the brain's agents read and a playbook proposal to avd-swarm cites (docs/contracts.md C11). The raw packages stay in the vault (C1). The snapshot must validate against contracts/schemas/current-state-facts.schema.json and pass the guard (scripts/AvdBrain.psm1, Get-BrainSensitiveText). Any error refuses it: fix the producer, never the snapshot. Without -Apply it only prints. -Apply copies the snapshot to <VaultPath>/facts/<estate>/<generatedUtc>.json. It refuses to write inside this repository, because a snapshot is still one estate's data and belongs in that estate's private vault.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-FactsPath` | string | yes |  | The snapshot avd-current-state wrote (avd-current-state-facts/v1). |
| `-VaultPath` | string | no |  | The estate's private vault, where -Apply files the snapshot. |
| `-Apply` | switch | no |  | File the snapshot in the vault; without it the script only prints. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Import-CurrentStateFacts.ps1 -FactsPath ./avd-current-state-facts-20261018T090000.json
```
```powershell
./scripts/Import-CurrentStateFacts.ps1 -FactsPath ./avd-current-state-facts-20261018T090000.json -VaultPath ../avd-brain -Apply
```
